dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, kind and generous Ioroi, and all other tanuki! I promise I'll bring you lots of treats next time, so please, let me go this once!

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Hmph! And here I thought you were a fast runner, little nekomata. Yet you can't even catch a few little tanuki? Tsk! Youth these days — no discipline at all!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: #Oho! The hide-and-seek master has shown {M#himself}{F#herself}. Ask {M#him}{F#her} for lessons!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Please, help me reason with Ioroi! I really, really don't have time to play today. I've got a whole pile of deliveries left!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Every time a delivery takes me through Chinju Forest, Ioroi stops me and has me play hide-and-seek with the little tanuki!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: It's fun to play with them every now and then, but when it's every single time... Well, I'm on the clock!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: After all, it's not like I can just sit around here all day every day like Ioroi...

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Hmph! Y—You insolent little nekomata! I am Ioroi, Hidden Protector of the Grove! It is a most heavy responsibility I bear! What do you mean, "sit around here" — do you mean to say that I am idle?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: A "heavy responsibility," huh? ... True enough. You're pretty heavy, now that you're a big ol' rock.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: But that's not the point! Hurry up and lift the barrier spell, or I'm gonna be late delivering my packages!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: *sigh* Why are young youkai all so impetuous? Did you really think I'd hinder your duties?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Gyoubu Koban, has the package been delivered?

response.speaker: "Gyoubu Koban"
response.text: Yes! Left it on the table!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Huh? Wait, when did you... My package...

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Ha, still so young, little youkai. I knew who the package was for the moment you set foot in my forest, and while you wandered about, had Gyoubu Koban go and...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: My... delivery receipt...

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Wh—What's wrong? You... why are you suddenly radiating such intensity?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: My delivery receipt... is stuck on top of the box...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: If they don't sign it, then the delivery isn't considered complete... And if they throw away the box, I may as well have never delivered the package at all...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: ...If this delivery was for nothing... Then you're not getting any moss cleaned next time I'm in Chinju Forest!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: And once you're all overgrown, you'll just be a big dumb rock that nobody can even see!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Gaaah! Y—You... COOOOOME BAAAAAACK! Gyoubu Koban, after her! You absolutely, positively must help her get that... receipt thingy back!
